yds5k8t1.baseName: Christmas Tree World 5ft Snowy Scots Pine Christmas Tree
yds5k8t1.variantName: Christmas Tree World 5ft Snowy Scots Pine Christmas Tree
yds5k8t1.sourceDescription: Packed with character, the Snowy Scots Pine is one of our most charming trees. Unlike plain green Christmas trees, the Snowy Scots Pine comes with lightly flocked bottle brush style branches which draw the eye without stealing the show from your favourite festive decorations. The range is also the perfect choice for those unsure about going for a fully frosted Christmas tree. Where an all-over flocked tree could perhaps be a little too 'modern' for some tastes, the Snowy Scots Pine expertly balances the old with the new, providing a timeless artificial tree that all Christmas guests will adore. Picture shows 7ft tree in our range. And let's not forget the very best bit the Snowy Scots tree comes with pre-attached pine cones! It's this final festive flourish that makes it one of our most unique collections - and a favourite among the kids! Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 5ft • Number of Branch Tips: 477 branch tips • Tree Width: 92cm diameter • Foliage colour: Green with light flocking and frosting • Realistic look: A stunning mix of PE/PVC and large bottle brush branch tips • Easy assembly: Attached hinged branches • Sturdy base: Folding metal stand with plastic tips to prevent scratching • Fire resistant: Fire retardancy certified • Indoor use only: The trees construction will rust in rain • Height measured from the floor • Picture shows 7ft Model • Eligible for European shipping • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

xxa4f8v5.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Fairy Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 150 cm
xxa4f8v5.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Fairy Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 150 cm
xxa4f8v5.sourceDescription: This Artificial Christmas Tree captures the holiday magic with its vibrant design and season-inspired aesthetic. Perfect for those seeking a modern twist on a traditional favorite, this tree marries simplicity with elegance, fitting seamlessly into any living room, garden, or terrace. The contemporary style—characterized by clean lines and minimal ornamentation—brings a sleek look to any festive setting, creating a warm, inviting atmosphere. PVC and Steel Build: Constructed from a blend of PVC and steel, this artificial tree offers a robust structure designed to last season after season. The abrasion-resistant material ensures longevity, while the steel stand provides excellent stability, easy to assemble with just a screwdriver. Energy-Efficient LED Lights: Equipped with LED string lights, this tree features energy-saving properties and dynamic lighting patterns. With 8 distinct flash modes, these lights illuminate the tree in intricate patterns, creating vibrant light displays that enhance any holiday décor. Convenient USB Power Source: This tree's innovative USB connectivity offers flexible power options, making it easy to power up without needing a traditional outlet. Simply plug it into a portable power bank or any compatible device, offering hassle-free setup. Stylish Modern Design: The cone-shaped frame and modern design elements make this tree a stylish addition to homes or outdoor spaces with shelter. Its sleek appearance fits smoothly into minimalist or contemporary setups, enhancing the visual appeal of any seasonal scene. Easy Assembly and Care: Designed for ease, assembling this tree is simple. With only a screwdriver and a partner needed, it's ready to impress. Follow care instructions for assembly efficiently, ensuring the tree remains a staple holiday decoration for years. Product Specifications Colour: White Material: PVC and steel Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 80 cm Durable Number of PVC tips: 380 Lights type: LED string lights Lights color: Pink Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
